title: On the Applicability of $p$-adic Numbers in Computational Modules for Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.20467v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The applicability of $p$-adic arithmetic as an intermediate computational module in an otherwise unchanged machine-learning pipeline is investigated. A one-feature linear regression on the scikit-learn Diabetes dataset serves as the test model. The fitted coefficients are represented in $\mathbb{Q}_p$, predictions are computed in that field, and rational reconstruction is applied to the outputs. In the pyAdic experiments, rational reconstruction either returns no result or produces values that differ from the baseline predictions; changing computational precision can change both the magnitude and sign of the reconstructed value. In SageMath, forward conversions succeed, but the reconstructed predictions differ from the baseline. An alternative representation based on digit reversal fails to preserve ordinary addition because of carry propagation. translated_title: 论p进数在神经网络计算模块中的适用性
translated_abstract: 本文研究了p进数算术作为一个中间计算模块在其余部分保持不变的机器学习流程中的适用性。以scikit-learn糖尿病数据集上的单特征线性回归作为测试模型。拟合的系数用Q_p（p进数域）表示，预测在该域中计算，并对输出应用有理重构。在pyAdic实验中，有理重构要么返回空结果，要么产生的值与基线预测不同；改变计算精度会同时改变重构值的大小和符号。在SageMath中，正向转换成功，但重构后的预测与基线不同。基于数位反转的另一种表示方法由于进位传播而无法保持普通加法运算。在所测试的设置下，没有任何一项测试预测被正确重构。
tldr: 本文通过线性回归实验研究了将p进数算术作为机器学习流程中间计算模块的可行性，结果发现有理重构无法正确恢复预测结果，且基于数位反转的表示会破坏普通加法运算，表明p进数在该应用场景下并不适用。
